stemMd: Two cyclists start 54 km apart and ride toward each other at 12 km/h and 15 km/h. How long until they meet?
explanationMd: Because they approach each other, the distance closes at 12 + 15 = 27 km/h. Time is 54/27 = 2 hours. Their travelled distances, 24 and 30 km, sum to the initial separation.

distractorRationale.c: The combined closing speed is 27 km/h, not 18.
distractorRationale.e: This uses only the slower cyclist’s speed.
distractorRationale.a: This uses only the faster cyclist’s speed.
distractorRationale.b: This divides by the difference rather than the sum of speeds.
